spans.s:
f. (-धूः)
1 The fore part of a carriage, the pole or the part where the yoke is fixed.
2 Agitation, trembling.
3 Reflection, recollection.
4 A spark of fire.
5 A burthen, a load.
6 A part, a portion.
7

Wealth.
8

A name of the Ganges.
E.
धुर्ब्ब to hurt, affix क्विप्, and व rejected; also with टाप् added, धुरा.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Bearing a burthen.
2 Bearing, (figuratively,) laden with good qualities, heavy duties, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A man of business.
3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
धुर् a burthen, and धृ to have, affix खञ्.

f. (-रा)
A burthen, a load.
E.
धुर्व्व to hurt, affixes क and टाप्.

(ई,) धूरी r. 4th cl. (धूर्य्यते)
1 To kill or hurt.
2 To move or approach.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Bearing, (as a burthen.)
2 Charged with, abounding with, (qualities, duties, &c.)
m. (-णः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A man of business.
E.
धुर् a burthen, ख aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Fit for a load, suited to a burthen.
2 Charged with important duties.
m. (-यः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A man of business.
E.
धुर्, and छ aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Fit for a burthen, adapted to it, &c.
m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A minister, a charge d'affaires.
3 A horse.
E.
धुर् a burthen, यत् aff.

(इ) धुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (धुर्व्वति)
To kill or hurt.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Bearing a load, a burthen.
m. (-हः)
1 A beast of burthen.
2 A minister, a charge d'affaires.
E.
धुर्, and वह who bears; also धुरावह.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Bearing a load, who or what does so.
2 Managing affairs.
E.
धूर्, and वह what bears.

m. (-टिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
धुर् a burthen, and जटि a collection, from जट to collect, and इन् affix; who collects or bears the burthen of the three worlds.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
1 Fraudulent, crafty, dishonest, knavish, &c.
2 Mischievous, injurious.
m. (-र्त्तः)
1 A gamester.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
3 Thorn apple, (Datura.)
n. (-र्त्तं)
1 Rust or iron filings.
2 Black salt.
E.
धुर्व्व to injure, Uṇādi affix तन्, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
1 A jackal.
2 A cheat, a rogue, &c.
E.
धूर्त्त crafty, कन् added.

m. (-वः)
A gamester.
E.
धूर्त्त, and कितव a knave.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Dishonest, a knave, a rogue, a cheat.
m. (-त्)
Thorn apple: see धुस्तूर.
E.
धूर्त्तं mischievous, and कृत् who acts.

m. (-न्तुः)
Man.
E.
धूर्त्त crafty, and जन्तु an animal; the subtlest of all animals.

f. (-ता)
Knavery, roguery, knavishness.
E.
धूर्त्त, and तल् affix; also with त्व, धूर्त्तत्वं.

m. (-लः)
A party of rogues or gamblers.
E.
धूर्त्त a cheat, and मण्डल a circle.

f. (-षा)
A plant: see रास्ना.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Bearing a load or burthen.
2 Managing affairs.
m. (-रः)
A beast of burthen.
E.
धूर् a burthen, and धर bearing.

f. (-र्व्वी)
The fore part or pole of a carriage.
E.
धुर्व्व to injure, affix अच् and ङीष्.
